0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, 1st in the West), who are on a six-game winning streak and have gone 4-0 on the road. Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) are out for New Orleans, and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. For Memphis, Quinten Post, Scotty Pippen Jr., and Ty Jerome are all day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet this season. They split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Pelicans won the last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
